name: dupefont
description: Identify fonts from images and find visually similar free font alternatives.

interface.longDescription: Show DupeFont a screenshot, photo, logo or design and it reads the typography, then ranks the closest free and open-source look-alikes. Every match comes with a similarity score, its licence, a live preview, and a link to its Google Fonts page or to a DupeFont page with more alternatives. Results are always openly licensed fonts, not commercial ones.
defaultPrompt: Identify the font in this image.
Find free font alternatives that look like this.
Compare this font with the closest free alternatives.
